episode_summary: Julia Hurley shares her journey from being voted out of a company to building a successful real estate business and athlete management firm. She emphasizes the importance of resilience, effective lead generation through open houses, and the power of personal branding. Julia provides actionable strategies for agents to re-engage past clients and leverage free tools to manage their business operations.
